AsteroidBiteJSON.Chance: Percent chance of a big missing piece: half of them are a Pac-Man mouth (wedge to the center), half a round bite at the side.
AsteroidBiteJSON.MinSize: Smallest bite (mouth angle or bite radius as a share of the asteroid radius).

AsteroidCavitiesJSON.MinCount: Fewest round caves inside each asteroid.
AsteroidCavitiesJSON.MaxCount: Most round caves inside each asteroid.

AsteroidCratersJSON.MinSize: Smallest crater radius as a share of the asteroid radius.
AsteroidCratersJSON.MaxSize: Largest crater radius as a share of the asteroid radius.

AsteroidDoubleJSON.Chance: Percent chance that a shaped asteroid is a double asteroid (two bodies with a neck). Checked after Torus.
AsteroidDoubleJSON.MinSize: Smallest body size, as a share of the space each body can use (0..1).
AsteroidDoubleJSON.MaxSize: Largest body size, as a share of the space each body can use (0..1).
AsteroidDoubleJSON.Neck: Neck thickness as a share of the smaller body (0.2-1). Thin necks can be cut by bites or tunnels; then only the bigger body stays.

AsteroidJSON.Id: Unique asteroid type id, used by biomes and player spawn rules and saved in worlds. Don't rename it in released mods.
AsteroidJSON.Name: Name shown in the editor.
AsteroidJSON.MinRadius: Smallest radius in blocks. Each asteroid gets a random radius between MinRadius and MaxRadius.
AsteroidJSON.DensityThreshold: How full the asteroid is (0-255). Higher values carve more away and make it smaller and more broken; lower values make it fuller. Default 33-45.
AsteroidJSON.NoiseOctaves: Detail layers of the surface noise. More octaves add smaller bumps on top of big ones. 2-4 is typical.
AsteroidJSON.NoiseScale: Size of the surface bumps. Larger values make smaller, more frequent bumps; smaller values make broad lumps.
AsteroidJSON.HasCavities: Adds 1-3 small round caves inside (new worlds) when there is no Cavities section.
AsteroidJSON.HasOreDeposits: Turns ore veins on. Off = the layers only contain their fill block.
AsteroidJSON.UsePerlinWorms: Carves winding tunnels through the asteroid, using WormSettings.
AsteroidJSON.WormSettings: Tunnel settings: how many tunnels, how wide, how long and how curvy.
AsteroidJSON.MinDistanceFromCenter: Biomes only pick this asteroid type at least this far from the world center, in blocks. New worlds only.
AsteroidJSON.MaxDistanceFromCenter: Biomes only pick this asteroid type up to this distance from the world center, in blocks. 0 = no limit.
AsteroidJSON.HollowCorePercent: Makes the inside empty: 40 = the inner 40% of the depth is hollow. 0 = solid, max 90. New worlds only.
AsteroidJSON.Cavities: Round caves inside the asteroid: how many and how big (radius in blocks). New worlds only.
AsteroidJSON.Shape: Random forms for new worlds: stretched blobs with lobes, double asteroids, rings, bites and craters. Without it the asteroid is a noisy ball.
AsteroidJSON.Layers: Rock layers from the surface (first) to the core (last), each with its fill block, thickness share and ore veins.
AsteroidJSON.Mobs: Mobs that live in this asteroid type. A mob listed by any asteroid only spawns in asteroids that list it; unlisted mobs spawn everywhere.

AsteroidLayerJSON.Name: Layer name for the editor.
AsteroidLayerJSON.FillBlockID: Block that fills this layer, for example light_rock. Ore veins replace it.
AsteroidLayerJSON.Ratio: Thickness share of this layer compared to the other layers (weights). 100/70/50 = the outer layer is the thickest.
AsteroidLayerJSON.Veins: Ore veins that can grow inside this layer.

AsteroidLobesJSON.Chance: Percent chance that a shaped asteroid gets lobes.
AsteroidLobesJSON.MinSize: Smallest lobe as a share of the asteroid radius (0.3 = 30%).
AsteroidLobesJSON.MaxSize: Largest lobe as a share of the asteroid radius.

AsteroidMobJSON.Mob: Id of the mob that lives in this asteroid type.
AsteroidMobJSON.Chance: Percent chance per spawn attempt on this asteroid. Lower = fewer mobs here.
AsteroidMobJSON.MaxPerChunk: Most mobs of this kind in one 32x32x32 block area. Empty = the value from the mob's Spawn section.
AsteroidMobJSON.MaxPerEntity: Most mobs of this kind on one asteroid. 0 = no limit (only MaxTotal of the mob counts).
AsteroidMobJSON.Layers: Layer numbers the mob may spawn in (0 = outer layer). Empty = all layers.
AsteroidMobJSON.MinDepth: Mob only spawns at least this deep: 0 = surface, 1 = core.
AsteroidMobJSON.MaxDepth: Mob only spawns up to this depth (0 = surface, 1 = core).
AsteroidMobJSON.MaxLightLevel: Brightest light the mob may spawn in (0 = complete darkness). Empty = the value from the mob's Spawn section.
AsteroidMobJSON.Biomes: Biome ids where this rule applies. Empty = all biomes.
AsteroidMobJSON.MinDistanceFromCenter: Rule only applies to asteroids at least this far from the world center, in blocks.
AsteroidMobJSON.MaxDistanceFromCenter: Rule only applies to asteroids up to this distance from the world center, in blocks. 0 = no limit.

AsteroidShapeJSON.Chance: Percent of asteroids of this type that get a random form. The rest stay classic noisy balls. 70 = 7 of 10 asteroids are shaped.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Stretch: How much the body may be squashed or stretched per axis (0 = round, 0.5 = up to 50% longer or shorter).
AsteroidShapeJSON.Warp: Bends the whole outline with slow noise so it looks irregular instead of geometric (0-0.6).
AsteroidShapeJSON.Roughness: Strength of the surface bumps (0-1). Low = smooth rocks, high = rugged and broken surfaces.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Lobes: Extra bumps grown onto the main body.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Double: Chance and size of double asteroids: two bodies joined by a neck.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Torus: Chance and thickness of ring (donut) asteroids.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Bite: Chance and size of a big missing piece: a Pac-Man mouth or a round bite.
AsteroidShapeJSON.Craters: Round craters cut into the surface.
AsteroidShapeJSON.RemoveFloatingBlocks: Keeps only the largest connected piece, so no loose blocks float around (asteroids up to 256 blocks across).

AsteroidTorusJSON.Chance: Percent chance that a shaped asteroid is a ring (donut). Checked first, before Double.
AsteroidTorusJSON.MinTube: Thinnest ring tube, as a share of the asteroid radius.
AsteroidTorusJSON.MaxTube: Thickest ring tube, as a share of the asteroid radius (max about 0.35).

AsteroidVeinJSON.BlockId: Ore block of this vein, for example iron_ore.
AsteroidVeinJSON.SpawnChance: Chance per block of the layer to start a vein, out of 1 000 000. 10000 = 1% of the blocks start a vein.
AsteroidVeinJSON.CanSpawnNearVoid: Off = veins never start next to air, so the ore is hidden inside the rock.
AsteroidVeinJSON.MinDepth: Vein only starts at least this deep: 0 = surface, 1 = core. 0.3 = not in the outer 30%. New worlds only.
AsteroidVeinJSON.MaxDepth: Vein only starts up to this depth (0 = surface, 1 = core). New worlds only.
AsteroidVeinJSON.MinDistanceFromCenter: Vein only appears in asteroids at least this far from the world center, in blocks (rare ores farther out). New worlds only.
AsteroidVeinJSON.MaxDistanceFromCenter: Vein only appears in asteroids up to this distance from the world center, in blocks. 0 = no limit.
AsteroidVeinJSON.NearCavesOnly: Vein only starts within 2 blocks of a cave or tunnel, so players find it while exploring. New worlds only.
AsteroidVeinJSON.BiomeMultipliers: Changes the vein chance per biome in percent (biome id: percent). 200 = twice as common there, 0 = never.

BiomeJSON.Id: Unique biome id, used in generator.json, asteroid mob rules and vein BiomeMultipliers.
BiomeJSON.Name: Name shown in the debug overlay (F3) and the editor.
BiomeJSON.SpawnChance: Share of the biome noise this biome gets compared to the other allowed biomes (weights, not percent). 0 = never chosen.
BiomeJSON.DebugColor: Color of this biome in the editor biome map and the debug overlay (RGB 0-255).
BiomeJSON.MinDistanceFromCenter: The biome only appears at least this far from the world center (0,0,0), in blocks. New worlds only.
BiomeJSON.MaxDistanceFromCenter: The biome only appears up to this distance from the world center, in blocks. 0 = no limit. New worlds only.
BiomeJSON.Density: Percent of asteroid candidates kept in this biome. 100 = normal, 50 = half as many, 150 = denser. New worlds only.
BiomeJSON.MinDistanceBetweenAsteroids: Extra spacing in blocks between asteroids in this biome. Only used when larger than the generator value. 0 = generator value.
BiomeJSON.RadiusMultiplier: Scales the size of every asteroid in this biome. 1 = unchanged, 1.5 = half again as big.
BiomeJSON.OreMultiplier: Scales the chance of every ore vein in asteroids of this biome. 1 = unchanged, 2 = twice as many veins.
BiomeJSON.WormSettings: Replaces the tunnel settings of every asteroid in this biome. Leave empty to use each asteroid's own WormSettings.
BiomeJSON.Asteroids: Asteroid types that appear in this biome with their weights (asteroid id: weight). Higher weight = more common.

BlockJSON.ID: Unique block id inside this GameSet (lowercase, no spaces). Recipes, drops and saves refer to it; renaming it breaks existing worlds.
BlockJSON.Name: Name shown to players in tooltips, the inventory and crafting. Must not be empty or the block is skipped.
BlockJSON.Description: Short description shown in the tooltip. Keep it short and without numbers; stats are added to the tooltip automatically.
BlockJSON.Type: Behaviour of the block, e.g. block, storage, furnace, generator, cable, door, sign, frame, pipe, thruster, cannon. Default block = plain solid block. Unknown types skip the block.
BlockJSON.Category: Crafting category the block appears in. Must match a category name from the crafting categories; empty = not listed in the crafting window.
BlockJSON.PowerToDrill: Drill tier needed to mine this block in survival. A drill mines it only if its tier is at least this value. Default 1, range 0-255.
BlockJSON.Mass: Mass of one block (1-255, default 1). Adds to the mass of the asteroid or ship, so heavy blocks make ships slower to accelerate and turn.
BlockJSON.Durability: How much damage the block takes before it breaks, from bullets, cannons and explosions (1-255, default 1). Damaged blocks show cracks and can be repaired.
BlockJSON.Efficiency: Work speed multiplier for machines (furnace, crusher, disassembler and similar). 1 = normal, 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half. Shown as Speed % in the tooltip.
BlockJSON.Textures: Block textures for each face, with an optional second set used when the block is inactive (machine idle or without power).
BlockJSON.Sounds: Sounds played when the block is placed, destroyed, and walked on in gravity. Unknown sound names fall back to the defaults.
BlockJSON.Drop: Item or block id dropped when the block is mined. Default $self drops the block itself.
BlockJSON.DropQuantity: How many items drop when the block is mined (1-255, default 1).
BlockJSON.FrontDirection: Which side of the model counts as the front, as a direction vector (default up: 0,1,0). Used to orient the block, its textures and multi-cell size when placed.
BlockJSON.IsTransparent: If true, light and the faces of neighbouring blocks show through it (glass, windows, thin models). Default false = solid opaque block.
BlockJSON.LightColor: Light emitted by the block as RGB 0-255. Default black (0,0,0) = gives no light.
BlockJSON.StorageSize: Inventory size of a storage block as columns x rows of slots (default 3x3, minimum 1). Only used by Type storage.
BlockJSON.Size: Size in cells for multi-cell blocks: X width, Y height, Z depth (1-16 each, default 1x1x1). Signs and frames set this from their own sections.
BlockJSON.CellPixels: Texture pixels per block cell on multi-cell blocks. 0 (default) = picked automatically so most textures fit; smaller textures repeat per cell.
BlockJSON.TextureFit: If true, each face texture is stretched once over the whole face of a multi-cell block instead of repeating. Default false.
BlockJSON.Unbreakable: If true, drills, weapons, explosions, collisions and mobs cannot break it; only creative players and commands remove it. Default false.
BlockJSON.Model: Shape of the block: a built-in shape name (e.g. slab) or an .obj file name from Models/Blocks without extension. Empty = normal cube.
BlockJSON.OxygenGenerator: Settings for an oxygen generator: which item fills its water tank and how fast water is used. Only used by Type oxygengenerator.
BlockJSON.Door: Settings for a sliding door: direction, speed, auto-close and sounds. Only used by Type door.
BlockJSON.Sign: Settings for a writable sign: width, text limits, colour, font and glow. Only used by Type sign.
BlockJSON.Frame: Settings for a picture frame: picture size and which picture items fit. Only used by Type frame.
BlockJSON.Cable: Optional textures that make a cable change its look by its connections (port, straight, angle, hub). Only used by Type cable.
BlockJSON.Generator: Power output of a power generator. Only used by Type generator.
BlockJSON.Gravity: Settings for a gravity generator: radius, strength, power use, fall damage and presets. Only used by Type gravity.
BlockJSON.DnaReconstructor: Settings for the respawn machine: DNA item used, power, revival time and sounds. Only used by Type dnareconstructor.
BlockJSON.Explosive: Explosion settings. Used by Type explosive (bombs). A Type generator with this section explodes when destroyed. Not set by default.
BlockJSON.Pipe: Settings for an item pipe: transfer speed, power and which sides take and give items. Only used by Type pipe.
BlockJSON.Disassembler: Power use of the disassembler. Only used by Type disassembler.
BlockJSON.Processing: Power use of a furnace or crusher. Power 0 = works without electricity. Only used by Type furnace and crusher.
BlockJSON.Thruster: Settings for a ship thruster: force, power and free space in front of the nozzle. Only used by Type thruster.
BlockJSON.Console: Settings for a ship console: number of key groups, power and what it controls. Only used by Type shipconsole.
BlockJSON.Cannon: Settings for a ship cannon: projectile, reload, aiming limits and power. Only used by Type cannon.
BlockJSON.ShipCamera: Power use of a ship camera block. Only used by Type shipcamera.

BlueprintJSON.Ingredients: Items needed to craft the product. $health or $power can be used to pay with the player's health or power.
BlueprintJSON.Product: Item made and how many. In a blueprint.json in a block or item folder, Item defaults to that entry.

CableJSON.Port: Texture name for a face where the cable connects to another electrical block. Texture name = file name without extension, global for the GameSet.
CableJSON.PortOff: Texture for Port when there is no power. Empty = same as Port.
CableJSON.Straight: Texture for a straight cable segment. If empty, the cable keeps its normal block textures and the other cable textures are ignored.
CableJSON.StraightOff: Texture for Straight when there is no power. Empty = same as Straight.
CableJSON.Angle: Texture for a cable bend (two connections at a right angle).
CableJSON.AngleOff: Texture for Angle when there is no power. Empty = same as Angle.
CableJSON.Hub: Texture used where three or more cables meet.
CableJSON.HubOff: Texture for Hub when there is no power. Empty = same as Hub.

CannonJSON.Projectile: Name of the projectile it fires, from the GameSet projectiles. Sets damage, speed and range.
CannonJSON.ReloadTime: Seconds between two shots of this cannon (minimum 0.05, default 1).
CannonJSON.ShotSound: Sound name played for each shot. Default ar.
CannonJSON.BarrelLength: Distance in blocks from the block centre to the muzzle where projectiles appear (minimum 0.5, default 1).
CannonJSON.AimCone: How far the barrel can turn away from its forward direction, in degrees (0-180, default 60). 0 = fixed forward.
CannonJSON.TurnSpeed: How fast the barrel turns towards the target, in degrees per second (1-3600, default 180).
CannonJSON.Power: Power used by the cannon, in EU (0-8000, default 15).

ConsumableItemJSON.UseCooldown: Seconds before the item can be used again. 0 = no wait. Default: 0.
ConsumableItemJSON.Sound: Sound played when used. Sound name = audio file name without extension, global for the GameSet. Default: default.

CraftingCategory.Id: Unique id of the crafting tab. Items with this Category are listed in it.
CraftingCategory.Name: Tab name shown in the crafting window.
CraftingCategory.Icon: Id of the item or block whose icon is shown on the tab.
CraftingCategory.Row: Row of the tab bar the tab is placed in, starting at 1. 0 or a missing row = put in the shortest row. Default: 0.
CraftingCategory.Group: Group tab at the top of the crafting window (for example Blocks, Items, Ships) that lists this category. Empty = Blocks for row 1, Items for row 2. Default: empty.

CraftingJSON.Categories: Tabs of the crafting window. Items join a tab through their Category.
CraftingJSON.Blueprints: Crafting recipes: the ingredients needed and the product made at a crafting table.

DefaultItem.ID: Item or block id to give at the start.
DefaultItem.PutIn: Where the item goes: auto (equipment slot if it fits, else the hotbar), hand (hotbar slot SlotId, selected), hotbar, inventory or equipment.
DefaultItem.SlotId: Hotbar slot for hand or hotbar (0 = first). -1 = first free slot.

ProcessingJSON.Power: Power used by the furnace or crusher, in EU (0-8000, default 0 = no electricity needed). It only works while its network has enough power.

DisassemblerJSON.Power: Power used while working, in EU (0-8000, default 40). Speed is set by Efficiency.

DisassemblyItemJSON.Item: Id of the item or block this exception is for.
DisassemblyItemJSON.Disabled: If true, the item can't be disassembled at all. Default: false.
DisassemblyItemJSON.ReturnPercent: Percent of the ingredients given back for this item, 0-100. Empty = DefaultReturnPercent. Ignored when Products are listed.
DisassemblyItemJSON.DurationSec: Seconds one disassembly of this item takes. Empty = the source recipe's time or DefaultDurationSec.
DisassemblyItemJSON.InputQuantity: How many of the item one run takes. Empty = the amount its recipe makes (1 when Products are listed).
DisassemblyItemJSON.Products: Exact items given back, instead of calculating them from the crafting or machine recipe. Empty = calculated.

DisassemblyJSON.DefaultReturnPercent: Percent of the crafting or recipe ingredients the disassembler gives back, 0-100. Default: 50.
DisassemblyJSON.DefaultDurationSec: Seconds one disassembly takes when the source recipe has no duration and the item sets none. Default: 10.
DisassemblyJSON.Items: Per-item exceptions: turn disassembly off, change return percent, time or input amount, or list exact products.

DisassemblyProductJSON.Item: Item or block id given back. It can't be the disassembled item itself.
DisassemblyProductJSON.Quantity: How many are given back per run, 1-255. 0 or less skips it. Default: 1.

DnaReconstructorJSON.DnaItem: Id of the item used up for each revival. Default dna_ui.
DnaReconstructorJSON.Power: Power used while working, in EU (0-8000, default 50).
DnaReconstructorJSON.Sounds: Sounds played during a revival: loop while working, a sound per stage, and one when the player appears.

DnaReconstructorSoundsJSON.Loop: Sound name looped while a revival is in progress. Default dnaReconstructionLoop.
DnaReconstructorSoundsJSON.Stage: Sound name played at each stage of the revival. Default dnaReconstructionStage.
DnaReconstructorSoundsJSON.Spawn: Sound name played at the block when the player appears. Default dnaReconstructionSpawn.
DnaReconstructorSoundsJSON.Volume: Volume of all three sounds (default 1 = normal).

DoorJSON.MoveDirection: Side the door slides to when it opens: Up, Down, Left, Right, Forward or Back, relative to the block. Default Right. Needs free space there.
DoorJSON.Speed: Opening and closing speed in blocks per second (minimum 0.1, default 2).
DoorJSON.OpenTime: Seconds the door stays open before it closes by itself (default 3). Only used when AutoClose is on.
DoorJSON.AutoClose: If true (default), the door closes by itself after OpenTime seconds.
DoorJSON.OpenSound: Sound name played when the door opens. Empty (default) = no sound.
DoorJSON.CloseSound: Sound name played when the door closes. Empty (default) = no sound.

DrillItemJSON.Tier: Drill strength. It can only mine blocks whose drill power (hardness) is at most this tier; higher tiers also mine faster. Default: 0.
DrillItemJSON.PowerUsage: Player power used per mined block (and every second while drilling a creature). The drill stops when power is lower than this. Default: 0.
DrillItemJSON.Range: How far the drill reaches, in blocks. Default: 6.
DrillItemJSON.Damage: Damage per second dealt to creatures and other targets hit with the drill. Does not affect mining speed. Default: 1.
DrillItemJSON.DrillColor: Color of the drill's light while mining, RGB 0-255. Default: blue (100, 116, 255).

EquipmentJSON.Slot: Equipment slot: Helmet, Shoulders, Chest, Arms, Legs, Boots, PowerGenerator, Flashlight or Scanner. An unknown slot skips the item.
EquipmentJSON.Health: Extra maximum health while worn. Bonuses of all worn items add up. Default: 0.
EquipmentJSON.Power: Extra maximum power while worn. Bonuses of all worn items add up. Default: 0.
EquipmentJSON.ExplosionProtection: Percent of explosion damage blocked, 0-100. Worn items add up, capped at 75% in total. Default: 0.
EquipmentJSON.Flashlight: Makes the item a flashlight when worn or held, with these light settings. Without it the player has no flashlight from this item.
EquipmentJSON.Radar: Makes the item a scanner when worn: sets how far object markers are shown and whether mass is shown.
EquipmentJSON.ArmorModel: Path of the .obj model drawn on the player's body, relative to the item folder or GameSet. Needs ArmorTexture too. Empty = not visible.
EquipmentJSON.ArmorTexture: Path of the PNG texture for ArmorModel, relative to the item folder or GameSet. Empty = armor not visible.

ExplosiveJSON.Radius: Blast radius in blocks (1-32, default 4). Players and objects take damage inside it.
ExplosiveJSON.Penetration: How much block durability the blast can break through along each ray (0-10000, default 100). Higher = deeper holes in strong blocks.
ExplosiveJSON.Damage: Damage dealt to players and creatures in the radius (0-10000, default 50). Armor explosion protection reduces it.
ExplosiveJSON.DamageFalloff: If true (default), damage drops to 0 towards the edge of the radius. If false, full damage everywhere in the radius.
ExplosiveJSON.PushStrength: How hard the blast pushes players, drops and loose objects away (0-200, default 15). 0 = no push.
ExplosiveJSON.PushRadiusMultiplier: Push reach as a multiple of Radius (1-8, default 2).
ExplosiveJSON.ChainDelay: Seconds before another bomb caught in this blast explodes (0-5, default 0.15).
ExplosiveJSON.DropBlocks: If true, destroyed blocks drop as items. Default false = they drop nothing.
ExplosiveJSON.DestroyStorageItems: If true, items inside destroyed storages and machines are lost. Default false = their contents drop.

FaceTextures.All: Texture for every face that has no texture of its own. Texture name = file name without extension, global for the GameSet.
FaceTextures.Up: Texture for the top face. Empty = uses All.
FaceTextures.Down: Texture for the bottom face. Empty = uses All.
FaceTextures.Left: Texture for the left face. Empty = uses All.
FaceTextures.Right: Texture for the right face. Empty = uses All.
FaceTextures.Forward: Texture for the front face. Empty = uses All.
FaceTextures.Back: Texture for the back face. Empty = uses All.

FallDamageJSON.SafeHeight: Fall height in blocks that causes no damage (default 5).
FallDamageJSON.DamagePerBlock: Damage per block fallen beyond SafeHeight (default 4).

FlashlightSettings.Intensity: Brightness of the flashlight beam. 1 = normal. Default: 1.
FlashlightSettings.Range: How far the beam reaches, in blocks. Default: 50.
FlashlightSettings.InnerAngle: Angle in degrees of the fully bright center of the beam. Default: 15.
FlashlightSettings.OuterAngle: Angle in degrees where the beam fades out completely; keep it larger than InnerAngle. Default: 25.

GameModeJSON.Id: Number of the mode, saved in worlds and player files. 0 Survival, 1 Creative, 2 Spectator; 3-31 for new modes. Must be unique in the GameSet.
GameModeJSON.Key: Short name for commands and the dashboard, e.g. gm explorer. Lower case, unique.
GameModeJSON.Name: Name shown to players.
GameModeJSON.Base: survival, creative or spectator: movement, inventory and interactions of the new mode. Ignored for ids 0-2.
GameModeJSON.Tag: Up to 3 letters shown as a small tag before worlds of this mode in the world list. Empty = first letter of the name.
GameModeJSON.TagColor: Tag colour as #RRGGBB. Empty = colour of the base mode.
GameModeJSON.Rules: What players may do in this mode. Rules left empty use the base mode's value.

GameModeRulesJSON.BreakBlocks: Players can break and drill blocks.
GameModeRulesJSON.TakeDamage: Players take damage (mobs, weapons, other players, explosions, falls, suffocation) and can die.
GameModeRulesJSON.NeedOxygen: Players use up oxygen outside air zones.
GameModeRulesJSON.Collide: Players bump into blocks and asteroids. Off = fly through everything (Spectator).
GameModeRulesJSON.UseGravity: Gravity generators pull the player down so they walk. Off = always float.
GameModeRulesJSON.MobsAttack: Mobs notice, chase and bite the player. Off = mobs ignore the player.
GameModeRulesJSON.ConsumeItems: Placing blocks, eating, repairing, spawning mobs and giving items use them up; the server checks the inventory. Off = items are never used up.
GameModeRulesJSON.DropItemsOnDeath: On death the inventory drops where the player died (unless the server keeps inventories).
GameModeRulesJSON.UseItems: Players can use and drop the items in their hotbar. Off = just watching.
GameModeRulesJSON.CreativeInventory: The inventory shows the creative window with every item for free.
GameModeRulesJSON.InstantBreak: Blocks break at once with any drill, like in Creative. Off = drilling takes time and drill power.
GameModeRulesJSON.BreakUnbreakable: Players can also break blocks that are normally unbreakable.
GameModeRulesJSON.AreaTools: Players can erase and fill whole areas with the creative area tools.
GameModeRulesJSON.ShipLibrary: Players can place saved ships from the ship library.
GameModeRulesJSON.FreeFlashlight: The flashlight works without a flashlight item.
GameModeRulesJSON.FullRadar: The radar shows everything without a radar device.
GameModeRulesJSON.CountStatistics: Distance and other player statistics are counted.
GameModeRulesJSON.StartItems: New players get the GameSet's start items.

GeneratorJSON.MinAsteroidsInSector: Fewest asteroid candidates placed in one sector (8192 blocks per side). Biome Density can keep fewer of them.
GeneratorJSON.MaxAsteroidsInSector: Most asteroid candidates placed in one sector. The real count is random between Min and Max, then filtered by biome Density.
GeneratorJSON.RejectionSamples: How many random tries the placer makes for each asteroid before it gives up. Higher fills crowded sectors better but takes longer.
GeneratorJSON.MinDistanceBetweenAsteroids: Minimum distance in blocks between asteroid centers in the whole sector. Biomes can ask for more with their own value.
GeneratorJSON.BiomesMapNoiseFrequency: Size of the biome regions. Smaller values make bigger regions (0.001 = regions of roughly a thousand blocks), larger values make many small patches.
GeneratorJSON.Biomes: Biome ids used in new worlds, in order. The order matters: each biome takes its SpawnChance share of the noise in this order.
GeneratorJSON.FallbackBiome: Biome used where none of the listed biomes is allowed at that distance from the world center. Empty = such places stay empty space.
GeneratorJSON.PlayerSpawn: Rules for the asteroid a new player starts next to.

GravityGeneratorJSON.Radius: Reference radius in blocks: the default setting of a new generator and the radius at which it uses exactly Power. Default 32.
GravityGeneratorJSON.MinRadius: Smallest radius in blocks players can set (1-1024, default 4).
GravityGeneratorJSON.MaxRadius: Largest radius in blocks players can set (up to 1024, default 512).
GravityGeneratorJSON.Strength: Reference gravity in m/s2: the default setting and the strength at which it uses exactly Power. Default 9.81.
GravityGeneratorJSON.MinStrength: Weakest gravity players can set, in m/s2 (0.1-100, default 0.5).
GravityGeneratorJSON.MaxStrength: Strongest gravity players can set, in m/s2 (up to 100, default 30).
GravityGeneratorJSON.Power: Power used at the reference Radius and Strength, in EU (default 200). Use grows with the chosen radius; 0 while switched off.
GravityGeneratorJSON.StrengthPowerFactor: How much the chosen strength changes power use (0..1, default 0.25). 0 = strength does not matter, 1 = use grows in direct proportion.
GravityGeneratorJSON.MaxRoomCells: For the inside-closed-rooms mode: the largest room in cells that still counts as closed (default 200000). Bigger rooms count as open.
GravityGeneratorJSON.FallDamage: Fall damage inside this field, used when no preset with its own fall damage is closest to the chosen strength.
GravityGeneratorJSON.EnabledOnPlace: If true, a newly placed generator starts switched on. Default false = it starts off until a player turns it on.
GravityGeneratorJSON.EnableSound: Sound name played at the block when it is switched on. Default gravityGeneratorOn; empty = no sound.
GravityGeneratorJSON.DisableSound: Sound name played at the block when it is switched off. Default gravityGeneratorOff; empty = no sound.
GravityGeneratorJSON.Presets: Quick strength buttons in the generator window (default Moon, Mars, Earth, Jupiter). The preset nearest the chosen strength also picks fall damage.

GravityPresetJSON.Name: Label of the preset button in the generator window.
GravityPresetJSON.Strength: Gravity set by this preset, in m/s2. Kept inside the generator's min and max strength.
GravityPresetJSON.FallDamage: Fall damage used while the chosen strength is nearest this preset. Empty = the generator's own FallDamage.

ItemJSON.Description: Text shown in the item tooltip under its name. Leave empty for no description.
ItemJSON.ID: Unique item id: lower-case letters, digits and _, 2-64 characters, not starting with a digit. Renaming it later removes the item from existing worlds.
ItemJSON.Name: Name shown to players in tooltips, the inventory and the crafting window.
ItemJSON.Type: What the item does: item (plain material), weapon, drill, consumable, repair_tool, mob_spawner, picture or equipment. Each type adds its own settings. Default: item.
ItemJSON.Category: Id of the crafting category (tab) the item is listed in, from Crafting/categories.json. Empty or unknown = not shown in the crafting window.
ItemJSON.Sprite: Item icon. Sprite name = PNG file name without extension under Items/, global for the GameSet. The 3D hand model is also built from it.
ItemJSON.MaxStack: How many fit in one inventory slot, 1-255. Weapons, drills, equipment and pictures always stack to 1. Default: 1.
ItemJSON.ModelDepth: Thickness of the 3D model built from the sprite when held or dropped. 1 = normal, higher = thicker. Default: 1.
ItemJSON.GlowColor: Glow color of the item model when held or dropped (RGB 0-255). 0,0,0 = no glow.

LootEntry.ID: Item id that can drop. The table name is the file name in Generation/Loot (used by chests and mob Loot).
LootEntry.Probability: Chance in percent (0-100) that this entry drops, rolled separately for each entry. Default: 100.
LootEntry.MaxCount: Largest amount dropped, capped at the item's stack size. Default: 1.

MobDeathParticlesJSON.Count: Number of particles, 0-200. 0 = no death particles. Default: 0.
MobDeathParticlesJSON.Speed: Particle speed in blocks per second, 0-20. Default: 2.5.
MobDeathParticlesJSON.Radius: Radius in blocks of the area the particles start in, 0-4. Default: 0.3.

MobJSON.Id: Unique creature id, used by spawner items, asteroid Mobs lists and commands.
MobJSON.Name: Name shown to players. Empty = the Id is used.
MobJSON.Behaviour: AI behaviour of the creature. Currently only parasite exists. An unknown value skips the creature.
MobJSON.Model: Path of the .obj model, relative to the GameSet folder, falling back to the game folder.
MobJSON.Texture: Path of the PNG texture for the model, relative to the GameSet folder, falling back to the game folder.
MobJSON.Scale: Size of the model and its hit area. 1 = original size. Minimum 0.05. Default: 1.
MobJSON.Radius: Radius of the collision sphere in blocks, 0.1-0.49. Default: 0.4.
MobJSON.MinDamage: Smallest damage of one bite on a player. Default: 5.
MobJSON.MaxDamage: Largest damage of one bite; each bite rolls between MinDamage and MaxDamage. Default: 10.
MobJSON.AttackRange: Distance in blocks from which it can bite. Minimum 0.5. Default: 1.6.
MobJSON.Speed: Normal movement speed in blocks per second (wandering, going to food). Default: 2.5.
MobJSON.ChaseSpeed: Speed in blocks per second while chasing a player. Default: 4.
MobJSON.FleeSpeed: Speed in blocks per second while running away from a player. Default: 5.
MobJSON.TurnSpeed: How quickly it turns to face its direction. Higher = faster turns. Default: 6.
MobJSON.SightRange: Distance in blocks at which it notices players inside its field of view. Default: 14.
MobJSON.FieldOfView: Viewing angle in degrees, 0-360. Players outside it are noticed only within HearingRange. Default: 140.
MobJSON.HearingRange: Players closer than this (in blocks) are noticed from any direction. Default: 4.
MobJSON.ForgetTime: Seconds after losing sight of a player before it gives up. Default: 4.
MobJSON.FleeChance: Percent of spawned creatures (0-100) that are timid and run away from players instead of attacking. Default: 0.
MobJSON.EatTime: Seconds it takes to eat one block. Minimum 0.1. Default: 3.
MobJSON.FoodSearchRadius: Distance in blocks it searches for edible blocks when hungry, 1-32. Default: 8.
MobJSON.MealIntervalMin: Seconds between meals when a player is within MealNearDistance. Default: 60.
MobJSON.MealIntervalMax: Seconds between meals when the nearest player is near MealFarDistance. Default: 600.
MobJSON.MealNearDistance: Player distance in blocks below which it gets hungry fastest (MealIntervalMin). Default: 24.
MobJSON.MealFarDistance: Player distance in blocks beyond which it never gets hungry, so far-away creatures don't eat the world. Default: 96.
MobJSON.EdibleBlocks: Block ids it eats. Empty = natural asteroid blocks. Also used by RequiresNaturalBlocks for spawning.
MobJSON.Loot: Loot table dropped on death: a file name from Generation/Loot without .json. Empty = no drop.
MobJSON.Spawn: Global natural spawn rules for this creature. Asteroid Mobs lists can limit it to certain asteroids and override some limits.
MobJSON.Sounds: Sounds the creature plays (idle, alert, bite, hurt, death, eat) and their volume.
MobJSON.DeathParticles: Particle burst shown when the creature dies. Count 0 = none.

MobSoundsJSON.Idle: Sound played now and then while idle. Sound name = audio file name without extension, global for the GameSet. Empty = silent.
MobSoundsJSON.Alert: Sound played when it starts hunting a player. Empty = none.
MobSoundsJSON.Bite: Sound played when it bites. Empty = none.
MobSoundsJSON.Hurt: Sound played when it takes damage. Empty = none.
MobSoundsJSON.Death: Sound played when it dies. Empty = none.
MobSoundsJSON.Eat: Sound played while eating a block. Empty = none.
MobSoundsJSON.IdleIntervalMin: Shortest wait between idle sounds in seconds (at least 0.5). Default: 6.
MobSoundsJSON.IdleIntervalMax: Longest wait between idle sounds in seconds. Default: 16.
MobSoundsJSON.Volume: Volume of all its sounds. 1 = normal. Default: 1.

MobSpawnJSON.Enabled: If true, the creature spawns naturally near players. Spawner items work either way. Default: false.
MobSpawnJSON.MaxPerChunk: Most creatures of this kind in one 32-block chunk. Asteroid Mobs entries can override it. Default: 1.
MobSpawnJSON.MaxTotal: Most creatures of this kind alive in the world at once. Default: 16.
MobSpawnJSON.MaxLightLevel: Spawns only where light is at most this level, 0-15. 0 = darkness only. Asteroid Mobs entries can override it. Default: 0.
MobSpawnJSON.RequiresNaturalBlocks: If true, spawns only next to a block it can eat (EdibleBlocks, or natural asteroid blocks), so not inside player bases. Default: true.
MobSpawnJSON.Chance: Chance in percent (0-100) that a spawn attempt is made. Default: 30.
MobSpawnJSON.MinPlayerDistance: Never spawns closer than this to a player, in blocks. Default: 16.
MobSpawnJSON.MaxPlayerDistance: Spawns only in asteroids within this distance of a player, in blocks. Default: 48.
MobSpawnJSON.DespawnDistance: Creatures farther than this from every player (in blocks) are removed. Default: 128.

MobSpawnerItemJSON.Mob: Id of the creature to spawn, from the Mobs folder. Using the item spawns it where you look; in survival one item is used up.

ModConfig.ModId: Unique id of the GameSet, saved in worlds. Block and item ids get it as prefix (default:iron). Without it the folder name is used. Don't change it after release.
ModConfig.ModName: Name shown in the GameSet list in Create World and the menus.
ModConfig.Description: Short description shown in the GameSet list.
ModConfig.Author: Author name shown in the GameSet list.
ModConfig.Version: Version text of the GameSet, shown to players. Default: 0.
ModConfig.OxygenConsumeInterval: Seconds between oxygen losses while the player is outside breathable air. 0 = oxygen is never used up. Default: 10.
ModConfig.Extends: What this GameSet is built on. "empty" = a GameSet of its own built on Empty. Any other id = an extension of that GameSet; "*" = an extension for any GameSet; a list ["default", "my_set"] = an extension for those GameSets.
ModConfig.Includes: Ids of other extensions that load before this one and are added to the world automatically. Only for extensions.
ModConfig.ItemsOnStart: Items given to a new player in survival. Equipment goes to a free equipment slot. Extension start items are added to these.
ModConfig.MinBaseVersion: Extensions: lowest Version of the base GameSet this extension works with. Older bases are refused. Empty = any.
ModConfig.MaxBaseVersion: Extensions: highest Version of the base GameSet this extension works with. Newer bases are refused. Empty = no limit.

Modlighting.AmbientColor: Base light color of the world (Optional/lighting.json), RGB 0-255. Darker values make unlit areas darker. Default: white.
Modlighting.FogColor: Color of the distance fog, RGB 0-255. Default: black.
Modlighting.FogDensity: Fog strength, 0-100. 0 = no fog, 100 = everything black. Default: 10.

OxygenGeneratorJSON.WaterItem: Id of the item that fills the water tank. Default water.
OxygenGeneratorJSON.TankCapacity: How many water items the tank holds (minimum 1, default 30).
OxygenGeneratorJSON.WaterConsumeInterval: Seconds of work per water item used from the tank (default 120). Water is only used while it is filling a room.
OxygenGeneratorJSON.WaterFillInterval: Seconds to move one water item from the slot into the tank (default 1, minimum 0.05).
OxygenGeneratorJSON.EmptySound: Sound name played at the block when the tank runs dry. Default oxygenGeneratorEmpty; empty = no sound.

PictureFrameJSON.Width: Width of the frame in blocks (1-4, default 1). Sets the block size.
PictureFrameJSON.Height: Height of the frame in blocks (1-4, default 1). Sets the block size.
PictureFrameJSON.Pictures: List of picture item ids that can be placed in this frame. Other pictures are refused.
PictureFrameJSON.ViewDistance: Distance in blocks up to which the picture is drawn (4-256, default 64).

PictureItemJSON.Picture: PNG file of the artwork, relative to the GameSet folder (usually Pictures/name.png). The Sprite is only the small inventory icon.
PictureItemJSON.Width: Width of the picture in blocks (1-4). It only fits frames of the same size.
PictureItemJSON.Height: Height of the picture in blocks (1-4). It only fits frames of the same size.

PipeJSON.TransferInterval: Seconds between moved items: the pipe moves one item per interval (0.05-60, default 1).
PipeJSON.Power: Power used by the pipe, in EU (0-1000, default 5).
PipeJSON.OutputSides: Sides the pipe pushes items to, relative to the block: Up, Down, Left, Right, Forward, Back. Default all but Down. Input sides are removed from this list.
PipeJSON.InputSides: Sides the pipe pulls items from, relative to the block: Up, Down, Left, Right, Forward, Back. Default Down.

PlayerSpawnJSON.MinAsteroidRadius: New players only start next to asteroids at least this big (radius in blocks). 0 = any size.
PlayerSpawnJSON.ExcludedAsteroids: Asteroid ids new players never start next to (for example ice asteroids without ores).
PlayerSpawnJSON.PreferredSpawnBiome: Biome id new players prefer to start in. Empty or none = any biome. Ignored when no asteroid of that biome is nearby.
PlayerSpawnJSON.MinDistanceFromCenter: New players start next to asteroids at least this far from the world center, in blocks. Ignored when none is found in the starting sector.
PlayerSpawnJSON.MaxDistanceFromCenter: New players start next to asteroids up to this distance from the world center, in blocks. 0 = no limit.
PlayerSpawnJSON.HealthOnSpawn: Health in percent of the maximum when a player starts or respawns (1-100).
PlayerSpawnJSON.PowerOnSpawn: Power in percent of the maximum when a player starts or respawns (0-100).
PlayerSpawnJSON.OxygenOnSpawn: Oxygen in percent of the maximum when a player starts or respawns (0-100).

PowerGeneratorJSON.Power: Power the generator produces for its electrical network, in EU (0-1600, default 50).

ProjectileJSON.Speed: Flight speed in blocks per second. Default: 5.
ProjectileJSON.MaxTravelDistance: Distance in blocks after which the projectile disappears. Default: 100.
ProjectileJSON.Length: Length of the visible tracer in blocks (visual only). Default: 1.
ProjectileJSON.Thickness: Thickness of the visible tracer in blocks (visual only). Default: 0.2.
ProjectileJSON.Damage: Damage to players and creatures on hit, 0-255. Default: 0.
ProjectileJSON.DamageBlocks: Durability damage to blocks, 0-255. Leftover damage carries on to the next block. 50 or more plays an explosion sound. Default: 0.
ProjectileJSON.Penetration: Strongest block durability it can damage, 0-255. Blocks with more durability stop it without damage. Default: 255.
ProjectileJSON.RicochetAngle: Hits flatter than this angle (degrees from the surface) bounce off instead of damaging. 0 = never ricochets. Needs PossibleRicochets.
ProjectileJSON.PossibleRicochets: How many times the projectile can bounce off surfaces (at most 5 are used). 0 = none. Default: 0.
ProjectileJSON.MaximumBlocksCanDestroy: How many blocks one shot can break through in a row while damage is left. Default: 1.
ProjectileJSON.DropBlock: If true, blocks destroyed by the projectile drop their item. Default: false.
ProjectileJSON.ImpactSphere: If true, a flash sphere and an explosion effect appear where the projectile ends (visual only). Default: false.
ProjectileJSON.ImpactExplosionRadius: Size in blocks of the explosion effect shown with ImpactSphere (visual only, no damage). 0 = no explosion effect. Default: 0.

RadarSettings.Range: How far away asteroid and ship markers are shown while this radar is equipped, in blocks (meters). Default 1000.
RadarSettings.ShowMass: If true, markers also show the mass of asteroids and ships. Default false.

RecipeJSON.Type: Machine that runs this recipe, matching the machine block's Type (for example furnace or crusher). In Recipes/<machine>.json it comes from the file.
RecipeJSON.DurationSec: Seconds the machine needs for one run. Default: 20.
RecipeJSON.Ingredient: Item put into the machine and how many one run uses. Only one recipe per machine and ingredient. In recipes.json it defaults to the folder's entry.
RecipeJSON.Product: Item the machine makes and how many per run.

RecipejSONType.Type: Machine type for all recipes in this group, matching the machine block's Type (for example furnace or crusher).

RecipesJSON.RecipeCatalog: Machine recipe groups, one per machine type, each with its list of recipes.

RepairToolItemJSON.RepairTime: Seconds to repair a fully damaged block. Damaged blocks heal proportionally faster.
RepairToolItemJSON.PowerPerSecond: Power used per second while repairing.
RepairToolItemJSON.Range: How far away blocks can be repaired, in blocks.

ShipCameraJSON.Power: Power used by the camera, in EU (0-8000, default 15). It must be powered to view through it.

ShipConsoleJSON.Buttons: Number of key groups players can bind ship parts to (1-16, default 8).
ShipConsoleJSON.Power: Power used by the console, in EU (0-8000, default 15). It must be powered to sit at it.
ShipConsoleJSON.Weapons: If true, the console only controls cannons (weapons station). Default false.
ShipConsoleJSON.Flight: If true (default), the console flies the ship: automatic thrusters and mouse steering. Ignored when Weapons is on.

ShipPhysicsSettings.MaxSpeed: Top speed of ships in blocks per second. Minimum 0.1. Default: 20.
ShipPhysicsSettings.MaxAngularSpeed: Top turning speed of ships in radians per second (1.5 is about 86 degrees per second). Default: 1.5.
ShipPhysicsSettings.LinearDamping: Speed a ship loses per second (blocks per second) when no thruster is firing. 0 = keeps drifting forever. Default: 0.25.
ShipPhysicsSettings.AngularDamping: Turning speed a ship loses per second (radians per second) when no thruster is firing. 0 = keeps spinning. Default: 0.03.
ShipPhysicsSettings.LinearSnap: Below this speed (blocks per second) a drifting ship stops completely. Default: 0.025.
ShipPhysicsSettings.AngularSnap: Below this turning speed (radians per second) a drifting ship stops rotating. Default: 0.003.
ShipPhysicsSettings.MaxStep: Longest physics step in seconds, 0.001-0.25. On slow frames ships move less instead of passing through blocks. Default: 0.05.
ShipPhysicsSettings.BoardDistance: A player this close to a ship block (in blocks) starts moving with the ship. Minimum 0.5. Default: 2.5.
ShipPhysicsSettings.LeaveDistance: A riding player farther than this from all ship blocks (in blocks) stops moving with it. At least BoardDistance + 0.5. Default: 5.
ShipPhysicsSettings.CollisionBounce: How much a ship bounces back when it hits something, 0..1. 0 = no bounce, 1 = full bounce. Default: 0.2.

SignJSON.Width: Width of the sign in blocks (1-4, default 1). Wider signs should use one texture spanning all cells (see CellPixels).
SignJSON.MaxLines: Maximum number of text lines players can write (1-16, default 4).
SignJSON.DefaultText: Text a newly placed sign shows. Empty by default.
SignJSON.TextColor: Default text colour: a colour name like white, black or red, or a hex code like #2b2118 (default).
SignJSON.Align: Default text alignment: left, center (default) or right.
SignJSON.PixelsPerBlock: Resolution of the text image per block of sign width (32-256, default 96). Higher = sharper text.
SignJSON.Margin: Empty border around the text in pixels of the text image (default 4, up to a quarter of PixelsPerBlock).
SignJSON.Glow: If true, the text is always fully lit, even in the dark. Default false = lit like the surroundings.
SignJSON.ViewDistance: Distance in blocks up to which the text is drawn (4-256, default 48).
SignJSON.Font: Path to a .ttf font file for the text. Empty (default) = the built-in pixel font.

SoundGroup.Place: Sound name played when the block is placed. Default blockPlaceDefault; unknown names use the default.
SoundGroup.Destroy: Sound name played when the block is destroyed. Default blockDestroyDefault; unknown names use the default.
SoundGroup.Footsteps: List of sound names for footsteps on this block in gravity, one picked at random. Empty = stone sounds on asteroid blocks, metal on others.

SpawnParametersJSON.GiveItemsOnStart: Items every new player gets, with where they go (hand, hotbar, inventory, equipment). Extensions can add more in their config.json ItemsOnStart.
SpawnParametersJSON.SpawnSettings: Where new players start and with how much health, power and oxygen. Also used for respawns.

TextureGroup.Active: Face textures used normally (and when a machine is working or powered).
TextureGroup.Inactive: Face textures used when the block is inactive (idle or without power) and for the build preview. Empty faces use the Active textures.

TexturePackInfo.Id: Unique id of the pack, used in the settings to remember which packs are enabled. Empty: the folder name.
TexturePackInfo.Name: Name shown in Mods > Texture packs.
TexturePackInfo.Description: Short text shown under the name.
TexturePackInfo.Author: Who made the pack.
TexturePackInfo.Version: Version of the pack, shown next to its name.

ThrusterJSON.Force: Thrust pushing the ship away from the nozzle face (0-100000, default 20). The effect depends on the ship's total block mass.
ThrusterJSON.Power: Power used by the thruster, in EU (0-8000, default 8).
ThrusterJSON.NozzleLength: Number of blocks in front of the nozzle that must stay free (0-16, default 0 = none).

TutorialChapterJSON.Id: Chapter id, unique in this tutorial (used for progress and rewards).
TutorialChapterJSON.Title: Chapter title shown in the tutorial panel.
TutorialChapterJSON.Icon: Item id or ui:name (UI texture) shown next to the chapter.
TutorialChapterJSON.Optional: Optional chapters can be skipped and do not block the tutorial.
TutorialChapterJSON.Reward: Items given when the chapter is finished. Never give an item that a task of the tutorial asks for.
TutorialChapterJSON.Steps: Steps in order. The player sees one step at a time.

TutorialJSON.Id: Unique tutorial id. Progress is saved per id, so do not rename it after release.
TutorialJSON.Name: Name shown in the tutorial menu.
TutorialJSON.Description: Short description shown in the tutorial menu.
TutorialJSON.GameModes: Game modes the tutorial is offered in (Survival, Creative). Empty = all.
TutorialJSON.Order: Position in the tutorial list; lower comes first.
TutorialJSON.Chapters: Chapters in order. Each chapter is a group of steps with an optional reward.

TutorialRewardJSON.Count: How many of the item are given.

TutorialStepJSON.Id: Step id, unique in its chapter (used for progress and rewards).
TutorialStepJSON.Title: Step title shown in the tutorial panel.
TutorialStepJSON.Text: Explanation text. {key:action} shows the key of an input action, {item:id} the item name.
TutorialStepJSON.Hint: Extra tip shown under the text. Same placeholders as Text.
TutorialStepJSON.Icon: Item id or ui:name shown next to the step. Empty = the icon of the first task item.
TutorialStepJSON.Skippable: Lets the player skip this step from the pause menu.
TutorialStepJSON.RequiresGameMode: Only show this step in this game mode (Survival or Creative). Empty = always.
TutorialStepJSON.Delay: Seconds before the step appears after the previous one.
TutorialStepJSON.ReadSeconds: Seconds the step stays when it has no tasks before it completes by itself.
TutorialStepJSON.CompleteSound: Sound played when the step is completed. Empty = the default sound.
TutorialStepJSON.Reward: Items given when the step is finished.
TutorialStepJSON.Tasks: What the player has to do to finish the step. All tasks are needed unless marked Optional.

TutorialTaskJSON.Type: Task type, for example press, hold, look, move, mine, craft, place, process, equip, open_ui, toggle, stat, pilot, wait, all_of, any_of.
TutorialTaskJSON.Label: Text of the task line. Empty = a default text for the type. Placeholders like {key:action} and {item:id} work.
TutorialTaskJSON.Icon: Item id or ui:name shown on the task line. Empty = the task item.
TutorialTaskJSON.Optional: Optional tasks are shown as bonus and are not needed to finish the step.
TutorialTaskJSON.Count: How many times or how many items (mine, craft, place, process...).
TutorialTaskJSON.Item: Item or block id the task is about (mine, craft, place, process, equip...).
TutorialTaskJSON.Block: Block id for tasks about blocks, when different from Item.
TutorialTaskJSON.Action: Input action for press and hold tasks, for example forward or flashlight.
TutorialTaskJSON.Seconds: Seconds for hold (held in total) and wait (time before it continues).
TutorialTaskJSON.Distance: Blocks to move for move tasks.
TutorialTaskJSON.Degrees: Degrees to turn the camera for look tasks.
TutorialTaskJSON.Stat: Player statistic name for stat tasks (a property of the player statistics, for example BlocksPlaced).
TutorialTaskJSON.Delta: How much the statistic has to grow during the step for stat tasks.
TutorialTaskJSON.Window: Window that must be open for open_ui tasks: inventory, crafting, pause, ...
TutorialTaskJSON.What: Thing to switch for toggle tasks: magnet or flashlight.
TutorialTaskJSON.State: Required state for toggle tasks: true = on, false = off.
TutorialTaskJSON.Flight: For pilot tasks: true = flight console, false = weapon console, empty = either.
TutorialTaskJSON.Slot: Equipment slot for equip tasks, for example Helmet. Empty = any slot.
TutorialTaskJSON.Machine: Machine for process tasks (furnace or crusher). Empty = either.
TutorialTaskJSON.Tasks: Sub tasks for all_of (all needed) and any_of (one is enough).

WeaponItemJSON.ReloadTime: Seconds between two shots (minimum 0.05). 0.1 = 10 shots per second.
WeaponItemJSON.Spread: Random spread of shots, 0-255. 0 = perfectly accurate, 255 = up to about 15 degrees off the aim. Default: 0.
WeaponItemJSON.PowerUsage: Player power used per shot. The weapon can't fire while the power bar is lower than this. 0 = free. Default: 0.
WeaponItemJSON.AnimationPushback: How far the held weapon model kicks back on each shot (visual only), 0-255. Default: 0.
WeaponItemJSON.Recoil: How hard each shot pushes the player backwards, 0-255. Most noticeable in zero gravity. 0 = no recoil. Default: 0.
WeaponItemJSON.AnimationSpeed: Speed of the shot kick animation. 1 = normal, higher = faster. Default: 1.
WeaponItemJSON.Projectile: Projectile fired, by its file name without .json from the Projectiles folder (for example p_laser). Extensions can only use base GameSet projectiles.
WeaponItemJSON.ShotSound: Sound played on each shot. Sound name = audio file name without extension, global for the GameSet.
WeaponItemJSON.Ammo: Item id used up as ammo, one per shot, taken from the hotbar or inventory. Empty = no ammo needed.

WormSettingsJSON.MinCount: Fewest tunnels that start in each 32x32x32 block area of the asteroid.
WormSettingsJSON.MaxCount: Most tunnels that start in each 32x32x32 block area.
WormSettingsJSON.DiameterInBlocks: Tunnel width in blocks. 3 is player sized; 5+ makes large caves.
WormSettingsJSON.PathDeviation: How curvy tunnels are: 0 = straight lines, 1 = they can turn in any direction.
WormSettingsJSON.StepSize: Spacing between the carved spheres along a tunnel, as a share of the width. Smaller = smoother walls, larger = bumpier tunnels.

ingredient.Item: Item or block id put into the machine. In recipes.json inside an entry folder it defaults to that entry.
ingredient.Quantity: How many one machine run uses, 1-255.

ingridient.Item: Item or block id needed. $health or $power pays with the player's health or power.
ingridient.Quantity: How many are needed for one craft, 1-255.

product.Item: Id of the item or block made. In blueprint.json or recipes.json inside an entry folder it can be left out for that entry.
product.Quantity: How many are made per craft or machine run, 1-255.

BlockTypes.block: Plain building block without any behaviour (hull, walls, decoration).
BlockTypes.interactive: Block the player can use with the use key; base type for simple usable blocks.
BlockTypes.mineral: Ore or rock found in asteroids. Gives its Drop item when mined; drill tier set by PowerToDrill.
BlockTypes.crusher: Machine that crushes items with the recipes in Recipes/crusher.json. Needs power.
BlockTypes.furnace: Machine that smelts items with the recipes in Recipes/furnace.json. Needs power.
BlockTypes.analyzer: Machine that analyzes items so the player learns new crafting blueprints.
BlockTypes.disassembler: Machine that takes items apart into their materials (disassembly.json). Needs power.
BlockTypes.craftingtable: Opens the crafting window to craft blueprints.
BlockTypes.radar: Shows asteroids, ships and players around it in the radar window. Needs power.
BlockTypes.cable: Carries electricity between blocks and looks like a wire (Cable section).
BlockTypes.generator: Produces electricity for the blocks it is connected to (Generator section).
BlockTypes.consumer: Uses electricity, for example lamps; glows or works only while powered.
BlockTypes.oxygengenerator: Turns water into breathable air inside closed rooms (OxygenGenerator section). Needs power.
BlockTypes.door: Sliding door that opens and closes when used (Door section).
BlockTypes.sign: Plate with text players can edit (Sign section).
BlockTypes.frame: Picture frame that shows picture items (Frame section).
BlockTypes.gravity: Gravity generator: players walk on floors near it while it is powered (Gravity section).
BlockTypes.claim: Claim beacon: protects the area for its owner while it is paid with items (multiplayer).
BlockTypes.dnareconstructor: Respawn point that rebuilds the player after death (DnaReconstructor section).
BlockTypes.explosive: Bomb that explodes when hit or triggered (Explosive section).
BlockTypes.pipe: Moves items between neighbouring containers and machines (Pipe section).
BlockTypes.thruster: Ship engine that pushes the ship (Thruster section).
BlockTypes.shipconsole: Seat to pilot a ship and bind its thrusters, cannons and cameras.
BlockTypes.cannon: Ship weapon that fires projectiles (Cannon section).
BlockTypes.shipcamera: Camera the pilot can look through from the ship console.
BlockTypes.invisible: Solid block that is not drawn, e.g. an invisible barrier.

ItemTypes.item: Plain item: materials, ingredients and other things without an action.
ItemTypes.weapon: Gun that fires projectiles, optionally using ammo.
ItemTypes.drill: Mining tool; its tier decides which blocks it can drill.
ItemTypes.consumable: Food, drinks and med kits that restore health, power or oxygen.
ItemTypes.mob_spawner: Places a creature where the player aims.
ItemTypes.equipment: Armor or device worn in an equipment slot; adds health, power or protection.
ItemTypes.picture: Picture that can be put into picture frames.

MobBehaviours.parasite: Crawls over asteroids, eats edible blocks and attacks players who come close.

TutorialTasks.hold: Hold an input action for a while (Action).
TutorialTasks.ship_travel: Travel a distance inside a ship (Distance).
TutorialTasks.stat: Raise a player statistic (Stat) by Delta.
TutorialTasks.process: Process items in a machine (Machine, Item, Count).
TutorialTasks.bind_ship_part: Bind a ship part to a key at a ship console.
TutorialTasks.have_item: Have items in the inventory (Item, Count).
TutorialTasks.equip: Equip an item, or anything in an equipment slot (Item or Slot).
TutorialTasks.select_hotbar: Select an item in the hotbar (Item).
TutorialTasks.toggle: Switch the magnet or flashlight on or off (What, State).
TutorialTasks.pilot: Sit at a ship console and pilot (Flight).
TutorialTasks.any_of: Finish one of the child tasks.
